_help: Volunteer stories for stories.html. Edit on GitHub (pencil icon), then commit: the site republishes itself. One story = one { } block, separated by commas. VOLUNTEERS ONLY: never a kid's story, name, age or photo here. Every real story needs the volunteer's written OK: put the month you got it in "consent" (like "2026-11"). Optional: "photo" (a file in images/stories/, faces of volunteers only), "rating" (1 to 5 stars), "featured": true (shown big at the top). While any story has "placeholder": true, the page stays out of search results and must not be linked from other pages: delete the placeholder blocks once real stories are in.

_example.name: First name, or first name + initial
_example.quote: What a session is like, a moment they remember, why they keep coming back. 40 to 80 words works best.
